category_edits.rationale: Across all four datasets, blend the existing weighted BPR objective with 10% unweighted pairwise softplus loss. This may improve candidate ordering while preserving the existing sampled negatives, scores, GRU architecture, inference, and training settings.

change_summary: Apply the specified 90/10 loss blend to each category's single GRU model using existing valid positive-negative pairs. No predictor changes are required.
